d: Ek sainik kekaiy naresh ko suchna deta hai ki alakshendr ka nidhan ho gaya. vahin sindhu ke yavan chhatrap pithan ne kekaiy naresh ko sandesh bhijvaya ki vah unki simaon se bahar nikal jae. chhatrap pithan ka aisa vyavhar kekaiy naresh ko apmanajnak lagta hai. vahin aambhi is bat se bhaybhit hai ki alakshendr ki mrityu ke pashchat yavnon men satta pane ki hor men vo kise batae ki rajy men kya ho raha hai. .... is rajnaitik uthaptak ke bich aage kya hoga - dekhie is bhag men
